profile.aboutMarkdown: I am a final-year Software Engineering student focused on backend and full-stack development. My primary stack is ASP.NET Core, Angular, and SQL Server. I am also expanding into Python backend development, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI application engineering, and cloud infrastructure.

projects.title: SchoolSaaS
projects.subtitle: Multi-tenant School Management SaaS
projects.shortDescription: A multi-tenant school management platform focused on secure tenant isolation, authentication, feature access, and maintainable backend architecture.
projects.overviewMarkdown: SchoolSaaS is a team project for managing school operations using a multi-tenant architecture. The backend focuses on authentication, tenant isolation, feature/subscription control, caching, and maintainable application architecture.
projects.seoDescription: Multi-tenant school management SaaS built with ASP.NET Core, Angular, SQL Server and Redis.

sections.title: My Responsibilities
sections.contentMarkdown:
- Worked on multi-tenant backend architecture.
- Implemented JWT access-token authentication and refresh-token rotation.
- Used TokenVersion and DeviceId in session-security design.
- Integrated Redis for token-version/session-related caching.
- Worked on subscription/feature access and audit/background processing.

items.title: Multi-tenant Architecture
items.description: Control/master data and tenant-specific data are separated to support tenant isolation.

items.title: JWT & Refresh Token Rotation
items.description: Authentication uses access tokens, refresh rotation, TokenVersion and device-aware session concepts.

items.title: Redis Caching
items.description: Redis is used for token-version/session-related caching.

items.title: Custom Request Pipeline
items.description: Cross-cutting behavior is handled through a custom request/handler and decorator pipeline instead of MediatR.

sections.title: Lessons Learned
sections.contentMarkdown: Working on SchoolSaaS strengthened my understanding of tenant isolation, authentication/session security, backend modularity, caching, and the trade-offs involved in building a SaaS architecture.

projects.seoDescription: RAG-based regulatory document platform with FastAPI, PostgreSQL, RBAC and department-based document access control.

sections.title: My Backend Scope
sections.contentMarkdown:
- Built and extended backend capabilities around the existing AI/RAG pipeline.
- Worked on authentication, refresh-token handling, RBAC and permissions.
- Implemented department-based document ACL.
- Applied access restrictions to document viewing and retrieval/chat flows.
- Worked on document upload, versioning, relations, effectiveness and audit requirements.

sections.title: Department-based Access Control
sections.subtitle: Authorization before restricted document knowledge reaches retrieval.
